# EEVSEC CyberRange: Full Reference

> EEVSEC CyberRange is a competitive, live-fire cybersecurity training arena. Two people enter one live scenario on separate isolated virtual machines (one attacks, one defends) in real time, with a state-aware AI Coach watching each side. It is not a course and not a CTF: there are no scripted walkthroughs, no fake boxes, and no passive videos. Operated by EEVSEC PRIVATE LIMITED, Ahmedabad, India (CIN U62013GJ2026PTC177190).

## Status
CyberRange is in pre-launch. Access is currently by waitlist (request access on the site); the description below reflects how the product works at launch. Joining the waitlist is free and collects only your name and email.

## What it is
CyberRange replaces passive lectures and predictable Capture-the-Flag puzzles with real-time, high-pressure defensive and offensive simulations on isolated virtual machines, guided by an AI Coach. The platform is browser-based with zero setup.

## Match flow
1. Pick your side: attack the system or defend it.
2. Pick a scenario: choose the mission you want to fight in.
3. Enter your VM: each player gets a separate, isolated machine.
4. Battle live: react to a real human opponent in real time; no resets.
5. Review with AI: see what happened, what worked, and what to improve.

## The AI Coach
- Side-aware: gives role-specific help for attack or defense.
- Command context: reads your last action and suggests the next concrete step plus why.
- Ask the coach: get unstuck with targeted hints.
- Isolated sessions: each side's guidance stays private to that account.

## Scenarios
- IoT & Semiconductor (device-layer): firmware, hardware, and chip-level attack surfaces.
- Digital Forensics (post-breach): reconstruct or cover memory, network, and disk evidence.
- Cloud & Zero Trust (enterprise): misconfigurations and lateral movement across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
- Adversarial AI (AI vs AI): AI agents attack and defend; the richest signal.
- Red & Blue Automation (generative): novel attack and defense chains from real sessions.
- SCADA / ICS (nation-state): power grids, water, and industrial controls.

## Who it's for
Corporate security teams, SOC analysts, recruiters and evaluators, learners, universities, and workforce trainers: anyone who needs hands-on practice that builds real skill under pressure.

## Why it works
Most labs test memory; CyberRange tests decisions. A live human opponent reacts to every move, full kill-chain scenarios run on real machines, and AI coaching is built into every round rather than bolted on.
